scope: Current local XOCE website visual identity, separate from native app UI standards.
status: Hierarchy and material refinement implemented locally; current verification is recorded separately. No publication implied.

name.treatment: Plain text; no logo or graphical favicon

typography.legacy_assets: Retained Space Grotesk files and licence are historical, not the current heading face

palette.treatment: Warm neutral light background and charcoal dark background, quieter static artwork, teal emphasis and distinct navigation/showcase/reading glass densities.

compositions.home: Short everyday-app introduction beside a compact glass showcase: official watch and app explanation side by side. Platform strip and current setup path, future shared-timer concept, three-column stages and contribution links; no standalone Phone promotion.
compositions.catalogue: Compact introduction and open rows with larger native captures, direct downloads and setup for the four available Pebble products. No enclosing catalogue pane, planned-app card or single-platform filter bar.
compositions.product: Recognizable watch/device presentation beside purpose and installation details.
compositions.about: Compact two-column opening, project rationale grounded in replaceable apps and interface exploration, platform row and readable stage progression, with one understated Phone-plan paragraph and plain link.
compositions.docs: A sole dense article surface with quiet sidebar and contents rails; native collapsed mobile disclosures.

device_presentation.kind: Official Pebble Appstore Time 2 frame around native emulator captures
device_presentation.native_captures: Unchanged bytes and 200:228 aspect ratio; matte black letterboxing avoids stretching in the taller aperture. Provenance remains in docs/asset-provenance.json.
device_presentation.claims: Native emulator screens composited with an official device frame; not a photograph of the running apps or physical-watch verification.
device_presentation.compact_views: Direct native screen captures remain useful for compact lists and documentation.
device_presentation.interaction: Home uses native CSS radios for four static app previews, with no automatic cycling.
device_presentation.licence_status: No permissive licence verified for the official frame; source-provided asset included for local review, with no additional licence granted.

artwork.source: Original geometric vector artwork authored for the XOCE website.
artwork.motion: None; static themed top-of-page mask, reduced on Docs.

interaction.appearance: System, Light and Dark; explicit choices saved in the browser.
interaction.controls: Flush controls, visible focus and brief hover/pressed feedback.
interaction.motion: No idle, pointer-following or automatic showcase animation; reduced motion respected.
interaction.transparency: Opaque fallbacks for unsupported backdrop filtering and reduced transparency.
interaction.focus: Ordinary visits leave inputs unfocused; explicit Search focuses its field.
interaction.without_javascript: Navigation, article reading, native disclosures, available-software catalogue and watch preview remain usable; search and theme controls enhance the static base.

design_references.observation: Project identity and distinct software within a broader ecosystem.
Explain connections through recognizable outcomes such as sharing files and controlling music.
Official Pebble hardware reference; frame image itself comes from the Pebble Appstore.
Readable product presentation and direct action hierarchy.
Material density suited to the task.

preserved: Plain-text XOCE and existing app icons
Software/Docs/About navigation with direct Docs article entry
Exact release links, licences and development status
Unchanged native screenshot pixels and provenance
Third-party notices and retained historical evidence
validation: Final rebuild verification is recorded in docs/qa/VALIDATION.json after checks complete; retained historical reports describe their own source.
